content.title: MavsTV | Dallas Mavericks
content.text: Stay in the gameSubscribe to the official streaming platform of your Dallas Mavs to watch live or past games, exclusive condensed games, original content, behind-the-scenes footage, and more, with more ways to watch than ever before!SEASON-LONGThe best bargain and simplest way to stream live or past games and other on-demand content!$14.99/SEASONAM I ELIGIBLE FOR MAVSTV?WATCH MAVSTV ON MORE DEVICESStream via Your Mavs AppStream at TV.Mavs.com on Windows/MacMavsTV App Available on Select ModelsMavsTV App Available on Select ModelsMavsTV App Available on Select ModelsMavsTV App Available on Select ModelsMavsTV App Available on Select ModelsComing Soon!FIND YOUR LOCAL LISTINGFREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONSMAVSTV+What is MavsTV?MavsTV is the OFFICIAL streaming platform of your Dallas Mavericks providing fans with unprecedented access through a centralized content destination to watch live or past games, on-demand highlights, original content, and exclusive behind-the-scenes footage on more devices than ever before.Check your zip code above to see if you are eligible to subscribe to MavsTV.+What content streams and features are available via MavsTV?In addition to streaming all local game broadcasts not exclusively televised nationally, including pre- and post-game shows, fans can access on-demand game replays, highlights, original content, and exclusive behind-the-scenes footage. Features include historic games, specialized series, player specific content, and more.+What games are available on MavsTV?All local game broadcasts not exclusively televised nationally, including pre- and post-game shows, are available with your subscription. Plus, on-demand replays and historical games, like the 2011 Championship run!+What devices are compatible with MavsTV?You can now watch on more devices than ever before via mobile, tablet and desktop web browsers by visiting TV.Mavs.com or downloading the MavsTV App on connected devices, including Apple tvOS, Android TV, Fire TV, Roku, and LG TVs. Download the Dallas Mavericks Official Mobile App to access MavsTV as well! Also available across NBA platforms and apps.+What is the MavsTV App?Fans with connected devices, including Apple tvOS, Android TV, Fire TV, Roku, Samsung, and LG TV operating systems can download the MavsTV App to conveniently access their subscription.+Is MavsTV available where I live?MavsTV is available to fans living within the Dallas Mavericks approved region. Subscribers can still access MavsTV within a 30-day period when traveling domestically outside approved region.If you decide to purchase MavsTV outside of the approved region, you will need to return to the Dallas Mavericks distribution area within 30 days to authenticate your location or you will be denied access without refund.Check your zip code here to see if you are eligible to subscribe to MavsTV.+Can I still watch live games on MavsTV when traveling?Subscribers can still access MavsTV within a 30-day period when traveling domestically outside the Dallas Mavericks approved region. After 30 days, your access will be denied until you return to the approved region and sign into your MavsTV subscription.+Can I subscribe to MavsTV if I live outside the Dallas Mavericks region?You can only access MavsTV inside the Dallas Mavericks approved region and while traveling domestically within a 30-day period thereafter.If you are outside the MavsTV region, you can purchase an NBA League Pass to watch live Mavs games.Check your zip code here to see if you are eligible to subscribe to MavsTV.+How can I access my MavsTV subscription?Access your subscription to MavsTV through TV.Mavs.com to stream via mobile, tablet, and desktop web browsers. You can also download the MavsTV App on connected devices, including Apple tvOS, Android TV, Fire TV, Roku, and LG TV. MavsTV is also accessible through the NBA App, NBA.com , and all NBA supported platforms. For a full list of supported devices, please visit supported devices here .+Will postseason games be included in MavsTV subscription?The NBA postseason for the 2025-26 season features nationally exclusive games only and will not be available on local broadcast or MavsTV. Information on where to watch NBA postseason games will be available closer to the end of regular season.+What is the MavsTV refund policy?You may cancel your subscription at any time, but no refunds, credits, or partial refunds/credits will be provided. If you cancel your Monthly or Season-Long subscription, you will continue to have access to MavsTV for the period paid for.+How many simultaneous streams does MavsTV allow?You may log into your MavsTV subscription on up to (3) separate devices. This allows three people to watch live games at the same time.+When are game replays available on MavsTV?Mavs Fastbreak, the new condensed-game show offering, will be available 30 minutes after each game ends, exclusively on MavsTV! Full game replays are added to MavsTV three hours following the end of the games correlated postgame show.+Will my MavsTV subscription automatically renew?Yes, both Monthly or Season-Long subscriptions will automatically renew. Monthly subscribers will be billed each month their subscription is active. Season-Long subscriptions will renew September 19, regardless of when subscription started. Season-Long subscribers will be notified via email 30-days prior to being charged for the upcoming season.+Can I subscribe to both MavsTV and NBA League Pass?Absolutely! However, local televised Mavs games will be blacked out on NBA League Pass when in the Dallas Mavericks approved region. If you would like to access games for other teams across the league, you can purchase an NBA League Pass in addition to your MavsTV subscription. Please note national and local blackouts will still apply to other teams.+Who can I contact if I am having issues?For issues signing in, please reach out to our support team here.For issues streaming, please reach out to MavsTVHelp@DallasMavs.com.For Season-Long subscribers looking for gift with purchase support or gift with purchase inquiries, MavsTV@dallasmavs.com.MavsTV Terms & Conditions
